dashboard.title: Dashboard

doctors.title: Medical team
doctors.desc: Manage physicians listed on the platform

login.lead: Manage inbound patients from the UK and beyond, keep your showcase current and put your physicians forward.
login.title: Clinic sign-in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your clinic administrator account.
login.backendHint: Your clinic account opens a JWT session via /auth/login.

account.retention: Deletion cannot be undone. The clinic name is kept for appointment history; phone, address and listing copy are erased. Open appointments are cancelled. When payment records exist they are kept for accounting duties.

errors.network: Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.loginBad: Email or password is incorrect. Check your details and try again.
errors.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this action. Sign in with the right account.
errors.notFound: We couldn’t find that record. Refresh the list or try another option.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email. Try signing in.
errors.dupAppt: You already have a request for this date.
errors.doctorConflict: The physician is not available on that date. Try another day.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with an existing record. Change the details and try again.
errors.validationEmpty: Something in the form is missing or invalid. Check and try again.
errors.validationOne: Check the {field} field and try again.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.server: That’s on our side — the team has been notified. Please try again.
errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

notify.n1d: Ahmed Al-Farsi · Hair transplant (DHI) request received.
notify.n2d: Your JCI accreditation file is with admin for approval.
notify.n3d: Your listing was viewed 17% more this week.

confirm.rejectBody: Are you sure you want to reject this request? This cannot be undone. The patient will be notified and the appointment will be cancelled.
confirm.appointmentBody: Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment? This cannot be undone. The patient will be notified and the slot may be offered to someone else.
confirm.photoBody: Are you sure you want to delete this photo? It will leave the showcase. This cannot be undone.
confirm.docBody: Are you sure you want to delete this document? The verification record is dropped and the file cannot be restored.
confirm.messageBody: Are you sure you want to delete this message? The patient will no longer see it. This cannot be undone.
confirm.accountBody: Are you sure you want to delete the clinic account? We will not ask why. This cannot be undone. The listing is taken down; contact details and message content are erased under KVKK.
confirm.accountSecondBody: This cannot be undone. The clinic account will close and the listing will leave the marketplace. Appointment history is kept in anonymised form for legal retention.
confirm.accountSecondAction: Yes, permanently delete the clinic account

permission.cameraId: We need camera or gallery access to add clinic photos, documents, and doctor photos. Files stay on this clinic record.
permission.cameraChat: We need file access to attach an image or document to this conversation.
permission.locationBody: We need location only if a map feature requires it. It is not shared outside that screen.
permission.locationOk: Location received — nearby clinics are highlighted.
permission.locationDenied: Location is blocked. You can turn it on in the browser site settings.
permission.notifyBody: We would like to send browser notifications for new patient requests and messages. You can turn them off at any time.
permission.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser. You can turn them on in site settings.
permission.notifyUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
